issues.description: Fallible VM value and collection APIs omit success postconditions needed to establish their documented cursor and result-length behavior.
issues.rationale: The selected review head constrains only short-buffer and Err behavior. It does not say that successful read_val/write_val consume exactly size_of::<T>(), or that successful collect returns the old remaining length. Callers therefore cannot derive the documented happy-path cursor/result facts. The next revision 48e9017 added exactly these Ok rows, independently confirming the root cause.

issues.description: The trusted generic Vec::index_mut specification omits the SliceIndex bounds-admissibility condition.
issues.rationale: This assume_specification is the verification contract for generic trait-method dispatch, but its handwritten existential postcondition does not carry SliceIndex::in_bounds. It can therefore describe an output without exposing the precondition required for safe indexing. The next revision replaces it with call_ensures on SliceIndex::index_mut, which imports the native declaration's baked requires.
